meta.title: Git Actions
meta.description: Guarded git workflow commands: /draft-commit drafts a commit message and prints it (committing and pushing happen only when you ask); /draft-pr drafts a pull-request title and body the same way; /create-branch-from verifies the source branch and offers similar ones when the name misses; /setup-protect-branch-hook installs hooks so main is never touched and release/* pushes need an explicit parameter.
